messages:
maya: Heads-up — Lumina Health returned the vendor risk form. They flagged a SOC2 scope change and asked for encryption/KMS details. Sharing quick summary.

maya: TL;DR: asked about PHI, non-prod data, KMS provenance, BYOK, and embeddings retention.

diego: can you paste the exact question? I'll draft the answer. :mag:

maya: question 12: "Do you process PHI or controller-owned PII in non-prod?" They also asked for KMS provenance and BYOK options.

elena: For SOC2 scope: we can confirm Lumina's production workload does not process PHI. Non-prod uses synthetic data only. I'll draft a legal statement they can attach to their questionnaire.

sam: FYI our onboarding checklist requires the DPA addendum for embeddings retention. Lumina wants 1 year retention — they asked if we can shorten to 90 days.

maya: propose 180 days as compromise. Diego — can you confirm if embeddings can be auto-deleted after 180 days via tenant policy?

diego: technically yes — we support tenant-level retention. Example API call:
```
PATCH /v1/tenants/lumina/policy
{"embeddings_retention_days":180}
```
We will need EngOps to schedule a deletion job for cached vectors older than the threshold.

onboarding-bot: Assigned to ENG-8852 (eng-ops) — scheduled follow-up in 2 business days. :white_check_mark:

elena: I'll produce the short legal blurb and the DPA addendum language. Maya, please confirm timeline with customer and whether they need BYOK proof.

maya: pinged Lumina (account@luminahealth.com) — asked if 180 days is acceptable and when their compliance board meets. :rocket:

sam: attaching KMS attestation: https://redwood.com/static/kms-attestation.pdf

diego: If they request BYOK, supported providers are AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. BYOK onboarding runs ~2 weeks and needs key rotation SOP from the customer.

maya: noted. will track in Lumina onboarding thread and mark as renewal risk if their review extends >30 days. thanks everyone. :pray:

sam: small note — retention change may affect storage costs for embeddings; we'll flag finance for an estimate if they pick 180d.

maya: added CS action item and next steps in the onboarding board. closing loop here for now.
